title.narrative: Förderung einer nachhaltigen Landwirtschaft in Uganda

description.narrative: Die Zielregion zeichnet sich durch ein starkes Bevölkerungswachstum mit einer hohe Urbanisierungsrate von ca. 50 % aus. The target region is characterised by strong population growth with a high urbanisation rate of approximately 50 %. A large part of the population lives from agriculture, most of whom are small farmers who produce both for their own consumption and, in part, for the market. The cultivated areas are small, with 96 % of agriculture classified as rain-fed farming, resulting in high climate dependency and the risk of food insecurity.
